feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds until later.


##Wind)##

East or southeast 6 to gale 8, decreasing east or northeast 5 to 7 through the morning. Then decreasing 3 to 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain, becoming occasional later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor until later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 4°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Wednesday, 18 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

E or NE 3 to 5, soon increasing E 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Thursday, 19 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

E 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7.


##State of sea)##

Moderate occasionally rough in the west.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain at first, then mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
##Friday, 20 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind at first.


##Wind)##

E or NE 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 early in the morning, then 4 or 5 in the afternoon, veering E or SE 3 or 4 later in the evening.


##State of sea)##

Moderate occasionally rough at first, soon falling slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

13°C
